source: Black Sword Hack - Ultimate Chaos Edition SRD v1.0.2, Combat: Helpless.
note: A player character at 0 hit points becomes Helpless. The player rolls this d6 once the fight ends or the character reaches safety. Results 1 to 5 immediately restore d4 hit points.

1.name: Scratched
1.text: The character is good to go except for a new scar.

2.name: Missed
2.text: One random piece of equipment is destroyed.

3.name: Impaired
3.text: Disadvantage on DEX tests for the rest of the session.

4.name: Injured
4.text: Disadvantage on all attribute tests for the rest of the session.

5.name: Butchered
5.text: Permanently lose 1 point of STR on a d6 result of 1 to 3, or 1 point of DEX on a d6 result of 4 to 6.

6.name: Killed
6.text: The character dies. Create a new character of the same level.
